title.narrative:
The first draft of the updated National Social Protection Strategy, resulting from extensive stakeholder consultation and analysis, was completed and circulated widely for national validation.
Over 109,000 vulnerable children and their caregivers had access to integrated social protection services offered by the Makani programme and 6,011 children benefited from the UNICEF humanitarian cash assistance.
